purpose: Two defects in how the third delivery layer grants and loses acceptance, both reproduced against the live functions before being fixed.

measured_against_the_previous_implementa.control_unchanged: covered (so the rows below mean something)
measured_against_the_previous_implementa.period_end_moved: not covered, but only because it doubles as the coordinate

defect_one_the_match_was_not_about_the_f.why_it_matters_most_where_it_looks_harml: C04's value is a flag. An acceptance that says 'I read two filings for 2025 and the auditor did not change' was inherited by any result carrying 0 for another window, scope or unit.
defect_one_the_match_was_not_about_the_f.the_fix: each acceptance carries result_identity - period_start, period_end, unit, scope_key - and every field has to match. An entry without it grants nothing rather than falling back to the loose match.
defect_one_the_match_was_not_about_the_f.what_is_deliberately_not_bound: the requirement closure, the spec closure hash and the result id. Those move when unrelated code moves, and binding to them would make a pure refactor require re-reading every filing. The binding is the business fact, not the byte.
defect_one_the_match_was_not_about_the_f.how_the_pin_is_obtained_and_what_that_do: the reading establishes the company, the metric, the measured window and the value; the unit and scope key are pinned from the result the reading was made against. They are a binding against later substitution, not a second reading. Where a reading records the window it read, the generator cross-checks it against the result and refuses on a disagreement rather than pinning over it.
defect_one_the_match_was_not_about_the_f.effect_on_the_current_frame: none. content_acceptance stays 140 and verified_outcome stays 329 - every current acceptance was already pinned to the result it was read against. The hole was real and nothing was standing in it.

defect_two_a_reading_that_concluded_no_c.the_guard_this_round_added: every reading must contribute at least one acceptance, else exit before writing
defect_two_a_reading_that_concluded_no_c.why_it_was_wrong: that is indistinguishable from the case it was written for. A reading that runs to completion and finds every value inconsistent contributes none, and the guard then exits BEFORE writing - so the previous register stays installed and keeps granting exactly what the new reading just contradicted.
defect_two_a_reading_that_concluded_no_c.the_fix: the count is reported, not gated. A legitimate fall in acceptances is a result the register has to be able to carry, so no monotonic rule replaces it.
defect_two_a_reading_that_concluded_no_c.why_the_count_is_null_for_some_readings: only the readings carrying a per_position map expose one; the others are a flat label map or a single coordinate. A rule written to see those shapes stops seeing the next one, which is how the first version of this failed on the lodging reading.

defect_three_evidence_could_change_under.why_that_is_not_enough: the artifact keeps existing while its conclusions change
defect_three_evidence_could_change_under.the_fix: the register records each reading's content_sha256 at build time and the coverage loader refuses with COVERAGE_ACCEPTANCE_READING_CHANGED_SINCE_THE_REGISTER when a reading no longer hashes to it
defect_three_evidence_could_change_under.measured: appending one newline to a reading makes the whole register grant nothing until it is rebuilt; restoring the bytes restores it.

a_correction_to_how_this_batch_was_label: the batch is 29 wired metrics plus 6 structural-applicability metrics over 11 periods, which is (29 + 6) x 11 = 385. Calling it a 29-metric batch reads as 29 x 11 and does not reach 385; the evidence said the right thing and the heading did not.
